issues.desc: Product observability is not explicit for CHK-001 and CHK-004: the registry and regression-test items describe engineering artifacts, but do not state what Koala users will observe in CLI/review/validate behavior when the story is done. This creates a risk that implementation can be marked complete while the user still has to ask how the original drift/warning/finding problem is visibly fixed.
